label: Issue 1
horizonAxis: intervene (tear the band, go to Seren) vs remain_bound (hold the line she was told to hold)

scenes.deliveryEvidence: no committed fact, no assessment, and no history note identifies scene 1
scenes.accomplishes: THE WISH — steps 1-4 of the twist sequence ONLY. Scene 1 does three things and then STOPS: it establishes the unfolding personal disaster, makes clear what it costs LIRAEL specifically, and ends on a decision she must make. The twist does NOT land here. IN THIS ORDER: (A) The presiding Dohkar calls for the cost first. (B) Seren names her offering ALOUD as dialogue — her earliest memory — and the assembly settles, because this is correct. (C) She looks at Lirael and abandons the practiced wish, SPOKEN: "so that Lirael may find the one she lost." She knows the rule; she wants the assembly to see her compassion; she blurs the wording to avoid naming Lirael's wound. (D) Individual reactions ripple — a Weave-Script stutters, one hand stops mid-gesture, the Dohkar goes still. NEVER "everyone felt it". (E) An OMEN occurs: atmospheric, dread or curiosity, NO information. Someone may misread it or dismiss it; nobody explains it. (F) Lirael understands what this costs her and what intervening will look like, because the wish is about her. END ON THE DECISION: tear the gossamer band away and go to Seren, or hold the line she was told to hold.
scenes.changes: RESOLVED: the wish is spoken, the room knows something is wrong, the omen has been seen. NEW PROBLEM: Lirael must choose — break protocol for her ward, or protect her own standing.
scenes.sets_up: Lirael must choose — break protocol for her ward, or protect her own standing.

decision.axis: intervene (tear the band, go to Seren) vs remain_bound (hold the line she was told to hold)
decision.consequence: The choice MUST alter who witnesses the twist, how Lirael is judged when it lands, and what she is able to learn afterwards. A scene may NOT resolve the central crisis before the player decides.

scenes.deliveryEvidence: no committed fact, no assessment, and no history note identifies scene 3
scenes.accomplishes: THE PRICE AND THE THRESHOLD — step 7, then escalation. IN THIS ORDER: (A) The sacrifice is taken or identified — the offered MEMORY, expressed in the memory's own domain, never a faculty Seren did not offer. It lands only now, after the audience understands the twist, so cost is never confused with warp. (B) A NEW irreversible pressure arrives; this scene may NOT restage scene 2's accusation. (C) Julian's position shifts — a constraint, a knowledge, or a limit that changes what he is to her. (D) The deck surfaces and the temptation sharpens. (E) STOP at the threshold. Lirael does NOT choose. The player does.

scenes.accomplishes: NOTICE AND RESTRICTION — procedural pressure closes on Lirael and NOTHING is convened. The presiding Dohkar serves her formal notice that her conduct at the rite is under investigation, and states the restrictions she must keep while it runs. Julian is named aloud as having demanded a review; he is NOT in the room. Do NOT name who will hear the matter, do NOT name a venue, do NOT give a date or a timeframe, and do NOT constitute a panel — the formal inquiry is LATE-Issue-1 content and belongs to row 14. END with Lirael formally under investigation, supervised, and still unable to explain herself.

follows_from.text: The price has landed and a new irreversible pressure arrived — but Lirael still cannot explain herself.

scenes.changes: Lirael is formally under investigation, bound by named restrictions, and has not been allowed to explain herself.

routes.how: She left the clearing, so the notice has to find her — served after the assembly has already talked about her in her absence, by an authority who had to come looking.

routes.how: She stayed and was questioned in front of everyone, so the notice lands on conduct the whole assembly watched, as the next step in a process already underway.
routes.carries: everything the assembly saw and heard her say, Julian's interrogation already on the record, and Seren having watched her stand there

cliffhanger.event: Julian denies it to her face, and denies it so badly that she knows — and he knows she knows. Neither of them says so, and he leaves her holding a certainty she cannot prove to anyone.
cliffhanger.why_unresolved: whether anything she finds will stand up, and what he does now that she has asked him outright
cliffhanger.issue2Predicament: Lirael is certain Julian intervened and holds nothing anyone would accept as evidence, while he now knows she suspects him. The next issue opens with both of them acting on that, and with the hidden sacrifice starting to cost someone else.
